scenarios.description: Interactive Apple-inspired material and motion reference for Windows UI v2.
Empty chat session with setup skipped and no provider key.
Chat page with a synthetic in-progress assistant turn.
Models page with dense token usage buckets for chart validation.
Provider settings page with a validation error state.
Advanced settings with a failed OpenClaw Doctor payload.
Gateway connecting banner and retry affordances.
Knowledge hub with draft/proposal queues populated.
Observability page with errored traces and node diagnostics.
Transport path exercises WS to HTTP to IPC fallback metadata.
Skill sandbox shows an execution timeout and budget evidence.
Conversation state includes a multi-agent handoff marker.
Knowledge hub contains a merge conflict review queue.
Channel diagnostics contain repeated reconnect events.
ClawGraph compile state includes a cycle diagnostic.
